title: FLAMMARION scout-drone downlink message (PROPOSED format)
description: Proposed message the EVA crew and habitat receive from the scout drone flying 100–150 m ahead of the crew. No such drone data exists: every message in this prototype is SIMULATED. Update rate: 0.2 Hz nominal in the demo stream (one message per 5 s simulation tick); the format is intended for 1 Hz nominal and 5 Hz while any dust_devils[] entry has confidence ≥ 0.5. Coordinates: IAU 2000 Mars, planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude, decimal degrees. All confidences are probabilities in [0, 1].

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the scan (simulated mission clock)

alt_agl_m.description: Altitude above ground level, m (0 when landed)

flight_state.description: LANDED = on the surface in low-power rest while the crew works at a waypoint (alt_agl_m = 0)

position_sigma_m.description: 1σ horizontal position uncertainty per axis, m (0.1226 m ⇒ 0.30 m at 95 %)

lead_distance_m.description: Along-track distance ahead of the crew, m (nominal 100–150; shrinks at the end of the route)

radius_m.description: Ground radius of the terrain scan, m

gsd_cm.description: Ground sample distance of the terrain scan, cm/px

dust_opacity_tau.description: Column dust optical depth at ~880 nm, dimensionless

dust_devils.description: Convective vortex detections in view; empty when none

pressure_drop_pa.description: Estimated core pressure drop (vorticity proxy), Pa

tangential_speed_ms.description: Estimated peak tangential wind, m/s (vorticity proxy)

range_to_crew_m.description: Current horizontal range to the crew, m

miss_distance_m.description: Predicted closest approach to the crew's current position, m

time_to_intercept_s.description: Time to closest approach, s; null when predicted miss distance ≥ 150 m or the vortex is receding

terrain_updates.description: Differences between the drone scan and the orbital baseline; empty when none

height_m.description: Height above (+) or depth below (−) local surface, m

is_new.description: true when the feature is absent from the baseline map

along_track_ahead_m.description: Distance ahead of the crew along the planned track, m (negative = already passed)

cross_track_m.description: Signed lateral offset from the planned track, m (+ right)
